elements.element: RevMed shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause refers generally to insurance, including product liability insurance, but does not expressly require commercial general liability insurance or a USD 1,000,000 per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: RevMed shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability aggregate limit is stated.

elements.element: RevMed shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added language requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If RevMed processes Customer Data, RevMed shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance. It does not demonstrate that RevMed does not process Customer Data, so the conditional preferred requirement cannot be treated as inapplicable.

elements.element: RevMed shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no express workers' compensation insurance requirement or requirement tied to applicable law.

elements.element: RevMed shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The clause requires evidence of insurance upon request, but does not specifically require certificates of insurance.

elements.element: RevMed shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly requires RevMed to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: RevMed shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly requires RevMed to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The redline adds exactly the two fallback minimum coverages and leaves the original insurance mechanics intact. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it omits specified CGL limits, workers' compensation, and certificates; it also supplies only the fallback E&O and cyber limits. Drafting is generally clear, though it does not specify whether the E&O and cyber limits apply per claim, per occurrence, or in the aggregate.
